The '''Sullustan task force''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] unit that participated in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The [[Task force/Legends|task force]] consisted of four [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] and scores of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Republic gunships]].

==History==
{{RPG}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] commandeered the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] task force and used it to reinforce [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Argul]], who were [[Battle of Argul|fighting]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|forces]] on the world. When the task force arrived on Argul, it quickly turned the the tide of the battle in favor of the Republic, leading to an eventual Republic victory on the world.
{{Endgame}}
